title: wg: protocol-06 §10 missing well-known URI and media type registrations
description: Erratum. §5.1 (L1019-1023) uses /.well-known/mimi-protocol-directory but §10 registers only four components (§10.1-10.4). RFC 8615 requires registering well-known URIs, and no media type is defined for request bodies (decision mimid-1wgh.5.33). Fix: add the registrations.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED: well-known URI and media type registrations missing (RFC 8615 §3 MUST, not §3.1). New issue (#H).

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/157
2026-10-19 #157 ready-for-PR; followup mimid-1wgh.37.83.
